premises.text: Many people struggle with gardening due to lack of knowledge and experience
premises.evidence_span: not all of us have a green thumb. Actually, most of us have a black thumb. We are overwatering, we are underwatering, we are just doing it wrong.

premises.text: Gardening products often contain toxic chemicals that are harmful to people and the environment
premises.evidence_span: most of these products actually have toxic chemicals, which is not only bad for you, but it's also bad for the environment.

premises.text: A self-watering garden can simplify the gardening process
premises.evidence_span: we've created the first fully assembled, self-watering garden that you can just bring anywhere with you.

premises.text: A coaching app can provide guidance and support to new gardeners
premises.evidence_span: we have a coaching app to keep you active, engaged, and get all your questions answered before you even know that you have them.

premises.text: The self-watering system uses sub-irrigation to efficiently deliver water to plants
premises.evidence_span: self-watering, this is sub-irrigation. And what we've done is we've created a proprietary piece of hardware, specifically in the water reservoir and the proprietary materials we're using to make water transfer immensely efficient.

premises.text: The planter is designed to be user-friendly and accessible for urban dwellers
premises.evidence_span: it has amazing connection points. You can pop in accessories for vertical growing to maximize your space as well as cold frames.

premises.text: Personalized support based on location and climate can enhance gardening success
premises.evidence_span: we can give you accurate information based on your location as well as your season, which is very, very important and typically forgotten.

value.text: Gardening can be made easier and more successful for everyone
value.evidence_span: With Avalo, you can grow anything, anywhere.

notes: No separate premises for product features as they all contribute to the same goal of simplifying gardening.
